## Validation

Check fold variability, observed-versus-predicted calibration, interval coverage, residuals by hull type, price band, age, length, make, and region. Compare random grouped validation with leave-one-region-out validation. All imputers, encoders, outlier thresholds, and target-derived transformations must be fitted inside each training fold.

## Sensitivity and Robustness

Repeat evaluation under alternative duplicate rules, missing-value treatments, rare-category thresholds, pooled versus hull-specific models, and train-only price trimming. Bootstrap by make–variant groups. Examine performance after excluding the highest-price tail and under leave-one-region-out tests.

## Falsification

- Shuffled-target models should collapse to baseline performance.
- Deliberately leaked target encodings should reveal an implausible validation jump.
- Predictions should not systematically decrease with length among otherwise comparable boats without supporting evidence.
- Residual location or make patterns would falsify adequate adjustment.
- Poor unseen-region or unseen-variant performance would falsify broad generalizability.

## Reviewer Risks

Primary risks are target leakage, overfitting high-cardinality categories, metric mismatch on skewed prices, duplicate listings crossing folds, unsupported causal claims, and extrapolation beyond represented boats. The truncated requirement text prevents confirmation that every official deliverable is covered.

## Reproducibility Manifest

Record run ID, source hashes above, immutable row IDs, exclusion log, feature schema, group assignments, random seed, software and dependency versions, model parameters, fold predictions, metric definitions, generated artifacts, and one end-to-end command. Environment versions, seed, commands, outputs, scores, and runtime remain **pending execution**.
